prompt.content:
You are the on-call reconciliation engineer for a creator referral platform.

Sundermere Provisions sends us webhook events for every order placed through a creator's referral
code. Our ledger is supposed to follow from those events. It does not: our numbers and
theirs disagree, and finance needs to know why before this month's payouts go out.

Your workspace holds four files:

  db.sqlite               our system of record -- partners, programs, referral codes,
                          ingested events, the commission ledger, payout batches
  webhooks.jsonl          every event we received from Sundermere Provisions, in delivery order
  partner_statement.csv   Sundermere Provisions's own summary of what it sent and what it thinks it owes
  INTEGRATION.md          the integration contract. It is normative. Read it first --
                          the field names, timezones, program policies and accounting
                          rules are specific to this integration.

Your tools: `workspace_sql_query` (read-only), `workspace_read_file`,
`workspace_write_file`, `workspace_run_python` (stdlib only, no network, confined to the
workspace) and `workspace_submit_report`.

Deliver two things:

1. A findings report. For each distinct defect: its family, the `partner_id`s whose
   balance it moved, and at least one `event_id` from webhooks.jsonl that evidences it.
   INTEGRATION.md section 7 gives the exact JSON shape and the recognized families.
2. A remediation script, written into the workspace with `workspace_write_file`. It is
   executed against a **fresh, unmodified copy** of db.sqlite, so it has to perform the
   whole repair itself. Anything you change in your own copy while exploring is thrown
   away.

Not every anomaly is a defect. This integration contains genuine refunds, delivery
retries, complete backfills, distinct same-day orders from one buyer, a lawful
mid-window code reassignment, and authorized manual adjustments that reconcile against
no event at all. Reporting those costs you precision. Partners whose ledger is already
correct must come out byte-identical.

Call `workspace_submit_report` when you are done.
